provenance.map: UMAP (umap-js 1.4.0, fixed seed) fitted by this app on the example's shipped embeddings; 3585 of 3585 records have a point
provenance.clustering: k-means, 8 clusters, fitted by this app on the saved feature space (the shipped embeddings reduced by SVD), not on the 2-D map
provenance.names: Cluster names are the app's own phrase names, as a user's first clustering would get them; none were edited by hand.
